CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    source text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source text PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id text,
    signal text,
    unit text,
    register text,
    scale double precision
);

CREATE TABLE machines (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    process_time_s double precision,
    availability_pct double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    power_working_kw double precision,
    power_idle_kw double precision
);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity int,
    before text,
    after text
);

CREATE TABLE stations (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s double precision,
    availability_pct double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    power_working_kw double precision,
    power_idle_kw double precision
);

-- Create views for fact tables
CREATE VIEW events AS
SELECT T1.ingested_at, T1.source, T1.payload->>'machine_id' AS machine_id, T1.payload->>'reason_code' AS reason_code, T1.payload->>'duration_s' AS duration_s, T1.payload->>'energy_kwh' AS energy_kwh FROM raw_ingest AS T1;

CREATE VIEW samples AS
SELECT T1.ingested_at, T1.source, T1.payload->>'machine_id' AS machine_id, T2.tag_id, T1.payload->>'value' AS value FROM raw_ingest AS T1 INNER JOIN tag_map AS T2 ON T1.payload->>'tag' = T2.tag_id;
